Already implemented + regression exists. DESTROY_FAILED retry on the common disable path: lichen_lora_l2_deinit accepts DESTROY_FAILED -> DEINITING with goto destroy_queue (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.c:469-474), needs_destroy_retry query at lora_l2.c:707, failed destroy sets LORA_DESTROY_FAILED (lora_l2.c:667), and the common disable path retries deinit instead of falsely reporting success (net_if_down path completes the retry). Regression: test_disable_retries_incomplete_queue_destruction (lichen/tests/ping_l2/src/main.c:551-607) corrupts a pool handle, asserts deinit fails, retry flag set, stats -ECANCELED, init refused, then repaired handle + net_if_down completes teardown and re-init succeeds. Landed in checkpoint commit 95d85c3747. Caveat: ztest runtime validation is on the Linux/Twister path (bead y7wh). No files changed this session.
